programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10
programme.desc: Seri Pagi dimulakan dengan Bacaan Al-Quran & Terjemahan seterusnya rancangan Permata Hati dan Kapsul Motivasi Jana Minda. Info Cuaca dan Berita MELAKAfm. Pada Hari Sabtu pula rancangan Yok Donga Be bersiaran melibatkan tiga negeri Zon Selatan iaitu Melaka, Negeri Sembilan dan Johor secara interaktif. Sementara pada Hari Ahad Mari Berpantun(interaktif)seni budaya warisan kita.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

programme.title: Relaks Mfm 8-12
programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan Santai Buskers dan juga Dari Studio Muzik. Seleksi lagu-lagu ketuhanan melayari Khamis malam Jumaat anda. Turut Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan rancangan IN-TREND pilihan lagu-lagu baru. Seleksi lagu-lagu dalam Senada Duet melayari malam Khamis anda Malam Bunga Bunga Cinta untuk yang curhat pada malam Jumaat bersama DJ Ain. Turut disajikan 'Waronk Dangdut pada Sabtu dan Syok 80-90 pada Ahad.

programme.desc: 嗨，小朋友们！欢迎来到《同学八宝箱》！这是一个藏着无数秘密和惊喜的超级宝箱！只要轻敲三下，里面就会跳出好听的童话故事、神奇的科学冷知识，还有超级爆笑的校园趣事！无论是在上学路上、放学途中，还是睡前的陪伴时刻，快和我们一起打开八宝箱，收获满满的快乐和智慧吧！

programme.title: City Papago 城市趴趴走
programme.desc: 真正的旅行，不在于去过多少地方，而在于是否真正融入过当地的生活。《城市趴趴走》带你跳出千篇一律的旅游攻略，走进各大城市的街头巷尾。我们带你探寻历史街区的建筑余温，打卡本地人流连的菜市场与深夜食堂，听原住民讲述古老而新鲜的故事。从古朴小镇到摩登都市，请收拾好心情，随我们一起漫步街头，体验最地道、最富有烟火气的城市微旅行。

programme.title: SANTAI 5-8
programme.desc: Segmen Santai 5-8 mengandungi zon muzik segmen Lagu 60 an pada Isnin Laguku Kuasa Dua pada Selasa Rabu Lagu dan Kenangan Khamis Secangkir Bicara/Nurul Al-Quran dan Jumaat La Khobar. Sabtu dan Ahad segmen Hello Hello MELAKAfm pilihan lagu dan ucapan pendengar

programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10
programme.desc: Seri Pagi dimulakan dengan Bacaan Al-Quran & Terjemahan seterusnya rancangan Permata Hati dan Kapsul Motivasi Jana Minda. Info Cuaca dan Berita MELAKAfm. Info trafik(call out) dan Topik Gegau Pagi interaktif bersama pendengar.Kokenut Shake Dulu Special (Temubual/Zon Iklan menyusul selepasnya. Pada Hari Sabtu pula rancangan Yok Donga Be bersiaran melibatkan tiga negeri Zon Selatan iaitu Melaka, Negeri Sembilan dan Johor secara interaktif. Sementara pada Hari Ahad Mari Berpantun(interaktif)seni budaya warisan kita.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

programme.title: Relaks Mfm 8-12
programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan Santai Buskers dan juga Dari Studio Muzik. Seleksi lagu-lagu ketuhanan melayari Khamis malam Jumaat anda. Turut Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan rancangan IN-TREND pilihan lagu-lagu baru. Seleksi lagu-lagu dalam Senada Duet melayari malam Khamis anda Malam Bunga Bunga Cinta untuk yang curhat pada malam Jumaat bersama DJ Ain. Turut disajikan 'Waronk Dangdut pada Sabtu dan Syok 80-90 pada Ahad.

programme.desc: 嗨，小朋友们！欢迎来到《同学八宝箱》！这是一个藏着无数秘密和惊喜的超级宝箱！只要轻敲三下，里面就会跳出好听的童话故事、神奇的科学冷知识，还有超级爆笑的校园趣事！无论是在上学路上、放学途中，还是睡前的陪伴时刻，快和我们一起打开八宝箱，收获满满的快乐和智慧吧！

programme.title: City Papago 城市趴趴走
programme.desc: 真正的旅行，不在于去过多少地方，而在于是否真正融入过当地的生活。《城市趴趴走》带你跳出千篇一律的旅游攻略，走进各大城市的街头巷尾。我们带你探寻历史街区的建筑余温，打卡本地人流连的菜市场与深夜食堂，听原住民讲述古老而新鲜的故事。从古朴小镇到摩登都市，请收拾好心情，随我们一起漫步街头，体验最地道、最富有烟火气的城市微旅行。

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: National Anthem
programme.desc: The broadcast of Malaysia’s national anthem, Negaraku, marks the beginning of the daytime broadcast schedule.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us is a compilation of human-interest stories from around the world. This episode features a Women-run hotel in Sri Lanka that empowers women through the tourism industry. It also highlights Traditional wooden toy-making in Channapatna, India, where local artisans strive to preserve their craft amid modernisation and competition from imported products. Efforts to save the northern white rhino at Ol Pejeta Conservancy in Kenya continue through in vitro fertilisation (IVF) technology to prevent the subspecies from becoming extinct. Meanwhile, Benin’s textile industry is expanding its local manufacturing capabilities, shifting from raw cotton exports to textile production to create jobs and boost the country’s economy. The episode also explores the importance of international engagement and dialogue in helping countries such as Malaysia compete in an increasingly interconnected world.

programme.title: Global Perspective
programme.desc: This episode of Global Perspective discusses the evolution of Malaysia’s foreign policy since Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim took office in November 2022, focusing on strengthening ties with Islamic countries in areas including the Palestinian issue, economic cooperation, education and moderation. The programme also highlights Malaysia’s strategic relations with Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan and Central Asia, as well as the potential for international media collaboration to strengthen diplomacy and deliver accurate information to global audiences.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us explores diverse cultural traditions, artistic expressions and heritage from around the world, including ice carving in Japan, a unique peanut butter art installation in Rotterdam, Arabian horse traditions in Palestine and camel racing in Australia. This episode also highlights the traditional fishing practices of the Imragan community in Mauritania, France’s return of historical Syrian artefacts, and Malaysia’s strategic role in strengthening international relations and amplifying the voices of the Global South.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: The Legion [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Broken Star [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Abandoned by her friends and family and with her career in jeopardy, starlet Markey Marlowe is sequestered in a duplex with a reclusive landlord who just may be more dangerous than she is.

programme.title: Mojave Diamonds
programme.desc: A former MMA fighter and his brothers must rescue their kidnapped family from a dangerous crime syndicate after $50M of illegal diamonds gets stolen.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: The Coca Cola Kid
programme.desc: A smug sales executive treks to Australia to improve regional sales and becomes embroiled in sexual and professional shenanigans.

programme.title: Tim
programme.desc: A somewhat mentally handicapped 20-year-old man works as a laborer, but everyone abuses his naivety. A nice 40-year-old American woman hires him one day and they become close. However, the town and his family see her as predatory.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: A South African gold mine foreman is unwittingly manipulated by an unscrupulous gang of financiers who want to flood the mine to raise the price of gold on the world market.

programme.title: Centigrade
programme.desc: A married couple find themselves trapped in their frozen vehicle after a blizzard and struggle to survive amid plunging temperatures and unforeseen obstacles.

programme.title: Override
programme.desc: In 2040, a female humanoid A.I. is hacked by her husband and forced to kidnap the U.S. vice president's son and execute him on live television.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: A deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.title: Enter The Clones of Bruce
programme.desc: Enter the Clones of Bruce dives into the Bruce Lee exploitation craze, otherwise known as Bruceploitation.

programme.title: Chosen Family
programme.desc: Ann (Heather Graham) is a yoga teacher struggling to achieve inner peace despite the fact her family is driving her crazy and her dating life is miserable.

programme.title: Johnny & Clyde
programme.desc: Johnny and Clyde are two serial killers who are on an endless crime spree. They decide to assemble a group of criminals and misfits to steal from Alana's casino and pull off the heist of the century.

programme.title: Hospitality
programme.desc: A woman with a checkered past must protect her son when a man brings trouble to her isolated bed and breakfast.

programme.title: The Cooler
programme.desc: In an old school Las Vegas casino, its top gambling jinx breaks his curse when he falls in love, much to his boss' consternation.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Peter Five Eight
programme.desc: Sam, a seemingly poised and glamorous real estate agent in a small mountain community is revealed to be an unhinged and troubled alcoholic with a dark secret, when a charismatic man in a black sedan named Peter shows up in town one day.

programme.title: Broadcast
programme.desc: After a billionaire creates a drug called INOC which stops the aging process, the future of a world where death no longer exists is seen. The story of the fate of mankind is told while also revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

programme.title: Blood Of Redemption
programme.desc: When the most powerful criminal empire in the land comes crumbling down from within, it is up to a former henchman to put the puzzle pieces together in order to find those responsible and extract revenge.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: Locked In [Extended Version]
programme.desc: A single mother must protect her daughter and herself during a heist gone wrong at a high-tech storage facility.

programme.title: Hideout
programme.desc: Evading police at a remote farmhouse after fumbling a robbery, four criminals discover that the family living there is not who they appear to be.

programme.title: Juvenile
programme.desc: Troublemaker Billy Forsetti falls for the beautiful Jennifer. But when a carjacking takes a turn for the worse, Billy finds himself in for trouble.

programme.desc: The Oddbods are facing new challenges! Pogo is shunned by everyone after his latest prank backfires, so he ventures to prove that he's a changed Bod. Then, Slick enlists Bubbles as his dance partner for an upcoming competition but is horrified to realize that she's the worst dancer ever! How will he get out of this commitment? Finally, Slick recruits Newt to be his assistant for his latest ambition: to be a great magician!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are having a very busy day! Zee needs some money, so he does some odd jobs, but his laziness makes him a less-than-ideal employee. Then, after a near-accident, Bubbles creates a health serum to improve a cow's intelligence, but a guinea pig eats it instead and develops a super-brain! Finally, it's photo day, and Slick is determined to make sure he's front and center in the picture this year.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a strange day for the Oddbods! When Zee is caught 'borrowing' electricity from Jeff, Jeff makes him clean up his messy house as payment. Then, Slick and Pogo get into a battle of 'one-upmanship' over who is the neighborhood's resident superhero, but their competition is less than heroic. The day gets even stranger when Newt finds a four-leaf clover and has an amazing run of good luck!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are getting into trouble! Pogo wants to go skydiving with Newt, but she doesn't want to go. He soon discovers the only thing that can get her to agree: the final sticker for her collection. Then, Pogo gets his hands on Bubbles' mind control chips and picks poor Fuse as the object of his latest experiment! Finally, Pogo convinces the others a monster is on the loose, but it's just another one of his pranks.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are making new friends and foes! First, Zee inadvertently picks up a piglet from a nearby farm and quickly forms a strong bond with his new friend. Then, Slick, with a little help from Bubbles, enters a 'Robot Wars' tournament! As he progresses through the rounds, his arrogance makes him an unlikely winner. Finally, Jeff discovers some unwanted nesting birds in his garden and a battle of wits begins!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are in a real panic! First, Fuse and Pogo find themselves stranded inside Jeff's house after he goes on holiday. They must find a way to get along until Jeff gets back! Then, Fuse is rescued by Newt from an embarrassing situation and takes it upon himself to repay the debt by becoming her hero. Finally, one of Bubbles' experiments ends up in Pogo's ice cream, and his customers start to experience terrible side effects!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The cul-de-sac is dealing with some new arrivals! First, there's an alien invader, in the form of a popcorn-obsessed creature that has cloned itself to look exactly like Newt, who is trapped on its spaceship! Then, Zee has the misfortune of having to babysit his disruptive niece and nephew who seem intent on wrecking both his home and his head! Plus, a pleasant afternoon barbecue takes a turn for the worse for Jeff.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are causing some trouble! Fuse is fed up with his friends' addiction to technology, so he insists they give up their phones for the day while they go hiking, but they soon get lost! Then, a movie set comes to the cul-de-sac, and Slick wants a part, but he's got some hot competition. Finally, Pogo shrinks himself to have some crazy fun in a remote-control car, but it quickly gets out of hand.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are facing some challenging situations! When Fuse gets a birthday present of a skydiving ticket, he's too proud to tell Bubbles he's scared of heights and tries to face his fears. Then, Zee is cupcake crazy! When he discovers Bubbles is running a cupcake factory out of her house, he finds it impossible to control himself. The challenges continue when Newt crashes one of Fuse's fishing expeditions and turns out to be a natural!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some new problems! Zee is zapped by an impatient Bubbles who is tired of his sluggishness. He soon finds himself sped up, but with some unintended side effects! Then, Fuse discovers his long-lost teddy bear, Mr. Snuffles, but as soon as he is found, he is lost again! Fuse goes to extreme lengths to find his bear. Finally, Fuse accidentally breaks Bubbles' totem pole and tries to cover it up.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some new problems! Pogo finally meets his match when he annoys an equally annoying and determined bird species called a 'Twitcher.' Finally, Jeff accidentally causes Pogo to crash-land, causing him to lose his memory, and Jeff decides to rehabilitate him.

Finally, after a mishap on a hot air balloon trip, Pogo and Jeff find themselves stranded on a desert island!

Fuse and Newt must work together to rehabilitate their friend back to normality.

programme.title: Keabadian Cinta
programme.desc: 3 couples falls in love with each other in 3 different love stories.

programme.title: Boyfriend Aku Dari ...
programme.desc: After being disappointed multiple times, Risya is introduced by a friend to Andy, a nerdy young man. They fall in love but in actuality, Andy is a boyfriend from 'hell'!

programme.title: Gengster Leng Chai
programme.desc: Black is a failure of a gangster, being too soft hearted with people. After meeting Mawar, he is determined to change despite the objections of others.

programme.title: Strawberi Karipap Sesat Kat Paris
programme.desc: Nini and Haikal start their big adventure to find their aunty Lisa who gets a job offer as a professional photographer in Paris. Unfortunately, their journey turns upside down when they arrive in Paris and ruin a newly-wed coupleís honeymoon.

programme.title: Nota Silam

programme.title: Bukan Cerita Cinta Cliche

programme.title: Puyah & Putat
programme.desc: Kisah pengembaraan Puyah, seorang gadis kampung becok yang disukai ramai, apabila dia melawat Kuala Lumpur dan termasuk set filem secara tak sengaja, dan tak semena-mena mula mendapat nama sebagai pelakon.

programme.title: Ting Tong, Love
programme.desc: Bored by his mother's insistence on his getting married, Hairi finally agrees on the condition that he could choose his own soul mate. Does the choice of Hairi meet with his mother's approval?

programme.title: Chomel
programme.desc: After her mother's death, Mimi's family fell apart. One day, Mimi finds Chomel, a cat and brings it home, only for it to cause a series of events that brings her broken family back together again.

programme.title: My Future Husband
programme.desc: Emily berharap untuk menemui bakal suami dan pada suatu hari muncul seorang lelaki bernama Atta yang mengaku dia adalah suami Emily dari masa hadapan.

programme.title: Mat So'od

programme.title: Anais Patah Hati Pertama Kali
programme.desc: Anais is a pastry chef in her thirties that is having a heartbreak for the first time in her life and having difficulties controlling her emotions.

programme.title: Mark Masuk Jawi
programme.desc: A comedy featuring Mark,an English man who has been married to Suraya. He is forced to confront his anxieties when his father-in-law directs him to undergo traditional circumcision as promised by his wife.

programme.title: Nyanyuk

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Boo! Did that scare you? If so, then you better steer clear of this super spooky Holiday Eatz Halloween episode with chef-host Kimberly Lallouz! But that would be too bad, because then you'd miss a menu featuring fun but grown-up Halloween eats like Jack O'Lantern Curry, served with Irish-inspired spiced Pumpkin Barmbrack bread. Next, you'd miss a ghostly surprise with her pan seared Black Cod buried in a pile of carrot-chip 'Autumn Leaves' and drizzled with mango sauce made with"... ghost peppers! Her 'Fet Ghede' (Haitian Day of the Dead) inspired beef rib follows"... with a rib bone connected to"... melting tender beef braised in Haiti's signature Epis spice and crunched-up with yummy pumpkin seeds. For a sweet ending, it's a 'Bag of Candy'"... or in this case, homemade profiterole stuffed with mascarpone and all of your favourite candies! See, that wasn't so scary, was it? Mwahahahaha!

programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Where is it?
programme.desc: During a game of hide and seek Deedee and Nino come across a panicky Mewmew who cannot locate his key. Deedee creates a spell to get back all of Mewmew’s missing things and in come his key, including his long lost bubble-cordion and pocket fork. But Mewmew doesn’t want those things back as he had already replaced them. So Deedee offers to keep them as she couldn’t stand the sight of them being thrown away. On the way they find Charlie hiding from his lost but newly found alarm clock that is chasing him. The clock won’t let Charlie sleep a bit by ringing all the time, so Deedee offers to take it along with the rest. Deedee gets many more additions to her lost and found group as many more citizens of Abra-Dabra are affected with lost things. But as Deedee doesn’t have any space to store them, she puts up a give-away store. Now everyone’s happy.

programme.title: Meep Meep Charlie's
programme.desc: Boris and Sandy are fighting over the water sprayer and drenching Uncle Charlie with it. This leaves Charlie with no choice but to call on Deedee’s magic. Deedee finds a spell to make friendship dust as the perfect solution. Whoever the dust falls on will be best friends with whoever they see first. Happy for getting the magic powder they all set off to see Boris and Sandy. But on the way the Doobydoos rush at them so suddenly that they fall all over them and the Doobydoos become friends of Charlie and carry him off. Nino tries to explain the situation to Deedee, but she is too busy to listen. Back over at Charlie’s, the Doobydoos are treating him as a king and tries to run away from his new friends. Deedee finds some of the missing magic powder but tries to find Charlie. Deedee tries to bring things back to normal with magic, but Nino is against it. programme.title: Where is it?
programme.desc: During a game of hide and seek Deedee and Nino come across a panicky Mewmew who cannot locate his key. On the way they find Charlie hiding from his lost but newly found alarm clock that is chasing him. The clock won’t let Charlie sleep a bit by ringing all the time, so Deedee offers to take it along with the rest. Deedee gets many more additions to her lost and found group as many more citizens of Abra-Dabra are affected with lost things. But as Deedee doesn’t have any space to store them, she puts up a give-away store. Now everyone’s happy.

programme.desc: Boris and Sandy are fighting over the water sprayer and drenching Uncle Charlie with it. This leaves Charlie with no choice but to call on Deedee’s magic. programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! The gang is complete again! Or so they think. It’s form 4 and the gang is separated into science and arts streams. Best friends, Mal and Adam are separated and have to find a way to get back together. By the end of it, the gang are in for the biggest shock of their lives!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. Mal, on the other hand, is going through an identity crisis. He hates football now and really wants to quit, but it’s so hard. By the end of it, they come out stronger. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. Without Alya, the gang decides it’s better to also focus on their studies first. While Alya thinks this is her time to shine and redeem her old self, her grades still plummet. She then turns to the unthinkable: to cheat in her exam! Consequently, causing her to be stripped off of her prefect position.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Alya navigates through school as a normal student now, while Zizi sets out to find out what is Adam’s relationship with Dato Idris. Meanwhile, Puan Bariah has called Alya’s parents to school due to her recent bad behaviour. Mal ends up consoling Alya, revealing that he lost his father due to the pandemic. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.desc: Dr. Matt rushes off to answer an urgent call from Flamingoland, where a pregnant rare pygmy goat may need an emergency caesarean. A fight has left one female with a nasty wound but she'd reluctant to receive treatment.

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.desc: Nicolás se pone celoso cuando Jonás le comenta que Jack invitó a Victoria a jugar pool y que está seguro de que esa noche su amigo va a lograr besarla. Builder no se amilana ante las exigencias de Nicolás de que deje tranquila a Victoria y comienzan a discutir al punto que se caen a golpes hasta que la joven Guanipa y un mesonero los separan; Victoria le reclama a Del Casal su actitud posesiva con ella; él la besa con pasión para demostrarle qué le da derecho a sentirse así. Eugenia llama a Yosmir para darle las gracias por la torta que le llevó cuando fue a visitarla; él aparte de reprocharle la forma en que lo trató frente a Fernanda, le dice lo que piensa de toda su familia logrando molestarla. Fernanda recibe una nota anónima donde le advierten que la estafa a Cantarrana no se va a quedar así y ella pagará por eso. Leopoldo advierte a Fernanda que está corriendo peligro, pero le asegura que él la va a proteger.

programme.desc: Leopoldo advierte a Fernanda que, contrario a lo que ella piensa, Florencia pudiera estar siendo utilizada por Hilario en su contra. Victoria se conmueve al ver a Nicolás bajo la lluvia esperando que ella le dé una respuesta; Clementina insta a su amiga a no ceder todavía. Eugenia se molesta al leer la nota que le envió Yosmir con el libro que le regaló sugiriéndole que, cuando vuelva a ir a la cancha de bateo, lleve a su mamá con ella. Nicolás le deja un mensaje en el celular a Fernanda pidiéndole que no salga de su casa, pues no saben qué quiere la persona que la está amenazando y él no se perdonaría que le pase algo por no haberla detenido a tiempo en su plan.

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E11 - World Cup 2014, Lahm, Beckenbauer, Germany, Bayern Munich, Guardiola

Paraguayan goalkeeper José Luis Chilavert didn’t shy away from creating his own legacy. Whether is big a footprint as Alf Ramsey, or as small as Paul the Octopus, it all happened on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E06 - 1966 World Cup, Eusébio, Portugal, Ronaldo, Mozambique, Primeira Liga
programme.desc: When people think of Portuguese football stars, it always seems to be Cristiano Ronaldo. But what about Eusébio? He was a World Cup star. Then there was the brilliant Italian Brains Trust of Vittorio Pozzo and Giuseppe Meazza. Can football survive without its stars? Brazil certainly didn’t cope without Neymar in 2014. So many storylines - on football’s greatest stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E05 - Pelé, Stockholm, Sweden, Eisenhower, The Beatles, World Cup 1958
programme.desc: The story of Pelé taking the World Cup by the scruff of the neck at the age of 17 is legend. And we all know what we went on to do after that. On the cusp of reunification, West Germany triumphed in 1990, while a couple of French legends helped their nation to the peak of World Cup glory in 1998. It’s all in this installment of Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E04 - Gerd Muller, 2010 World Cup
programme.desc: A ultimate story of commitment, Gerd Müller was a footballer for the people. Marcello Lippi - tasked with lifting Italy’s fortunes, delivers the Azzurri a famous victory in 2006. German keeper Oliver Kahn played hero and villain in 2002, but we have to return to 1966 to witness true heroics on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E08 - : Iniesta, Spain, World Cup 2010, Enrique, Barcelona, Tiki-taka
programme.desc: The World Cup is full of heart-rending stories, but not many pull at the heart strings like that of Spain’s Andrés Iniesta and Xavi. Dino Zoff, the man who inspired Italy to victory in 1982 is another great tale. Then there’s the fun and games of Vuvuzelas, Mexican Waves and WAGS. There’s much to discuss on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E12 - Zidane, Materazzi, World Cup 2006, Jacques Chirac, Czech Republic, Zizou
programme.desc: As we traverse the history of the World Cup, we revisit the wizard that was France’s Zinedine Zidane, and look back on Brazil’s Cafu, whose destiny on the world stage seemed preordained. For Northern Ireland’s Harry Gregg, his footprint was much more profound. And then there was Guus Hiddink - the brains behind South Korea’s inspired run on home soil, on Football’s Greatest Stage.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu

programme.title: Seribu Rindu

programme.title: Seribu Rindu

Pengantara bersama John Bear berserta krew kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di situ selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi gangguan lembaga misteri dan bunyi menakutkan sama saperti diceritakan. John Bear juga berkongsi pengalaman yang baru dilaluinya.

programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama (AMTA) bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

Tanpa disedarinya, pertemuannya dengan Jalal telah memerangkapnya dalam sebuah sindiket jenayah. Walaupun Haziq dijanjikan peluang untuk memperbaiki hidupnya, Amelia sentiasa mengawasi setiap pergerakannya dengan teliti. Larian Terakhir adalah sebuah filem yang menggabungkan genre aksi dan sukan dengan penampilan pelakon-pelakon seperti Fattah Amin, Amyra Rosli, dan Fahrin Ahmad, di mana setiap larian akan sampai ke kemuncaknya.

Oleh kerna disebabkan ketaksuban cintanya itu membuatkan Fahmi sanggup mencari seorang bomoh untuk menghidupkan semula Riana. Riana telah berjaya dihidupkan semula dan mereka bersatu sehinggalah Riana melahirkan seorang anak. Namun benarkah itu adalah Riana? Apakah yang akan terjadi kepada kehidupan Fahmi selepas itu?

Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Soal Hati

Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Rahsia
programme.desc: Dihantui gangguan misteri, sepasang suami isteri mula mencari punca kepada gangguan tersebut. Profesor Hamdan dan Ramlah serta anak mereka, Saiful dan Marina berpindah ke sebuah banglo lama di tepi laut. Mereka hidup aman dan damai bersama di banglo tersebut. Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Suratan Kasih
programme.desc: Sunny mengalami tekanan jiwa selepas melihat ibunya yang sedang berzina mati dibunuh ayahnya sendiri. Apabila meningkat dewasa, Sunny menjadi seorang pembunuh bersiri di sebalik kerjayanya sebagai komposer dan pemuzik. Mangsanya ialah golongan artis yang melakukan perbuatan zina. Dalam masa yang sama, Sunny mencintai seorang penyanyi baharu yang bernama Natasha.

programme.title: Mama Oh Mama
programme.desc: Ani, seorang perempuan yang berperwatakan liar sering melakukan perkara yang tidak dipersetujui oleh ibu bapanya . Dia sering mengunjungi kelab malam dan keluar bersama teman lelakinya . Walaupun dinasihati oleh orang gajinya, Ani tetap tidak berubah sikap.

programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk "Jangan Bernafas". Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. Pada mulanya, mereka menganggap ia hanyalah rasukan biasa dan kru di sebalik pembikinan filem tersebut, ingin menjadikannya sebagai "footage" menarik untuk tujuan promosi filem tersebut. Namun, seorang demi seorang menjadi sasaran rasukan dan juga pembunuhan, menyebabkan keadaan menjadi tidak terkawal... tetapi kamera yang digunakan, masih terus merakamkan aksi yang terjadi.

programme.desc: Dendam menguasai masyarakat Melayu Patani di Thailand Selatan. Kalah dalam pertempuran lembu jantan, lawannya dibunuh yang juga saudara kepada Mamat - yang berjanji untuk membalas dendam bagi kematian saudaranya. Sifat dendam dalam masyarakat Melayu tetap mengalir kerana isteri Mamat, Minah gagal untuk menghentikan kitaran kejam itu.

programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

Konflik berlaku apabila penjenayah tersilap menculik orang yang menyebabkan Faridah dan Hisham perlu melakukan sesuatu untuk menyelamatkan Azura.

programme.title: The Real Sister

programme.title: Matahari Tak Bercahaya
programme.desc: Telefilem ini mengisahkan Mastura, seorang penjaga taska dan isteri kepada Shazan yang menjalani hidup bahagia di kampung. Namun semuanya berubah selepas satu insiden ketika menerima rawatan di hospital menyebabkan Mastura dijangkiti HIV secara tidak sengaja, lalu hidupnya berubah dari disenangi menjadi dibenci masyarakat kampung

programme.title: Tentang Dia
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Gadis yang mengalami trauma selepas dikhianati oleh kekasihnya sehingga menjadi seorang yang tertutup dan penyendiri. Kehidupannya berubah selepas bertemu Rudi, seorang gadis yang membantunya kembali menikmati hidup. Pada masa yang sama, Randu yang mencintai Gadis terus berusaha mendapatkan hatinya, sehingga Gadis perlu berdepan dengan perasaan, kehilangan dan makna sebenar sebuah hubungan.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

programme.title: 6 Jilake
programme.desc: Sekumpulan samseng upahan yang dikenali sebagai “6 Jilake” ditugaskan oleh syarikat penjajah untuk menguasai lombong bijih timah di negeri Perak pada abad ke-18. Namun mereka berhadapan dengan seorang pendekar kampung yang hebat dan sukar dikalahkan, lalu tercetus konflik besar penuh aksi dan jenaka.

programme.title: Melawan Takdir
programme.desc: Filem ni kisahkan perjalanan hidup Quraisy Mathar sendiri (pengarah filem ni). Ia mengangkat pengalaman hidupnya yang penuh cabaran sejak kecil — kehilangan orang tersayang, jatuh bangun dalam hidup, sampai berjaya jadi seorang sineas. Cerita ni tunjuk bagaimana semangat, doa, dan keyakinan boleh buat seseorang bangkit walaupun diuji dengan pelbagai takdir yang pahit.

programme.title: Cincin Pusaka
programme.desc: Alina dan Sofian adalah dua beradik yang saling cemburu, berlumba mengalahkan satu sama lain sejak kecil. Setelah kematian nenek, mereka berebut untuk memiliki cincin pusaka nenek yang kononnya mempunyai magis tertentu. Tetapi pelbagai halangan terjadi untuk mereka mewarisinya. Mampukah mereka menghadapi segala rintangan demi sebentuk cincin pusaka?

programme.title: Madu Murni
programme.desc: Mustaqim, bekas guru mengaji yang kini bekerja sebagai penagih hutang demi menyara keluarga, berdepan konflik apabila isterinya, Murni, tidak merestui pekerjaannya. Atas cadangan rakannya, dia mengambil isteri kedua, Yati, lalu tercetus pelbagai konflik dan situasi lucu yang menguji rumah tangga mereka.

programme.title: Longkai
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang geng 'longkai' (tonto atau penunda kereta). Eddie dan Bada ialah adik-beradik longkai yang terkenal. Semua kenderaan yang ditunda oleh mereka akan dibawa ke bengkel Rimau. Walaupun dia seorang wanita, Rimau berperwatakan sedikit tomboy dan lasak. Rimau telah jatuh cinta dengan Bada, tetapi dia tidak pernah berani untuk meluahkan perasaannya walaupun dia nampak 'tough'.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Love Supermoon
programme.desc: Mengisahkan seorang lelaki dan seorang wanita yang menjalani kehidupan masing-masing tetapi sering bertemu di majlis perkahwinan atau parti yang dianjurkan oleh rakan-rakan mereka. Mereka hanya mengenali antara satu sama lain melalui gosip yang didengar, namun berpura-pura tidak mengenali setiap kali bertemu.

programme.title: Cucu Atok
programme.desc: Pak Zubir menjaga cucunya, Aiman yang menjadi yatim piatu apabila kedua ibu bapanya meninggal dunia akibat kemalangan. Bapa Aiman seorang usahawan berjaya dan telah mewasiatkan harta yang banyak kepada Aiman. Pak Ngah dan Mak Ngahnya berniat jahat untuk membolot harta tersebut. Niat mereka didorong apabila Juwita meminjam wang daripada Ah Long dan gagal melunaskan pinjaman.

programme.title: Jin Notti
programme.desc: Jin Notti, seekor jin nakal dari dunia jin, dihantar ke bumi untuk belajar menjadi baik dengan membantu manusia. Namun, misinya jadi huru-hara apabila dia jatuh cinta dengan gadis manusia bernama Amy, lalu mencetuskan pelbagai situasi lucu dan romantik antara dua dunia.

programme.title: Adik Kakak
programme.desc: Mengisahkan pengorbanan Hanum (45 tahun) yang menjaga kakaknya, Azizah (52 tahun) yang mempunyai masalah ketidakupayaan intelektual (Intellectual Disorder) peringkat sederhana.

programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord (Moses Chan). However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin (Edwin Siu) is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam (Nancy Wu) and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok (Matthew Ho) to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lam's status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning (Kelly Cheung). A “war on drugs" again breaks out …

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: ChatSAT
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)
programme.desc: The dating reality show "A Date with Goddess" is back with a bang, and the second season's love battlefield is all upgraded! "Golden Matchmaker" Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the "heart-fluttering light" and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks… More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses' hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the "Peanut Team," providing live coverage of the goddesses' dates.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: My Left Eye Sees Ghosts
programme.desc: Ho Lai-chu (Sammi Cheng), from a humble background, met Daniel on a trip and married him after only seven days. Before they could return to Hong Kong, Daniel tragically drowned. Lai-chu inherited a large fortune from her deceased husband, but felt extremely empty inside and spent her days indulging in alcohol and tobacco. One night, drunk, Lai-chu crashed her husband's beloved antique car on a quiet highway. Her soul was ejected from her body, and the ghost Wang Jingwei (Lau Ching-wan) appeared, forcing her soul back into her body. Lai-chu miraculously survived and began to see ghosts in her left eye… Since then, Lai-chu has longed to see her deceased husband, but has been unable to do so. However, she discovers many interesting things about the ghost Wang Jingwei, and from then on, Lai-chu's life begins to change slightly…

programme.title: Le Grand Tour de Seoul
programme.desc: The "Le Grand Tour de Seoul" is on its way again, with Samantha Ko, Kalok Chow, and Brian Chu set off to enjoy a fantastic stay in Seoul! The hosts will visit local Michelin-starred restaurants and savor top-quality Korean beef. Beyond the culinary adventure, the two male hosts will also have the opportunity to work out with Korean star and fitness icon Kim Jong-kook, followed by a delicious barbecue. The three will also enjoy personalized activities: Samantha will have a romantic date with a ceramic artist; Brian Chu will experience bespoke tailoring, showcasing his impeccable style; and Kalok will try on a styling session inspired by a top Korean celebrity, undergoing a glamorous makeover. This exclusive and enjoyable experience will lead viewers to the ultimate in Seoul's luxurious charm!

programme.title: Hong Kong Good Take
programme.desc: Hong Kong possesses a unique urban character, where old and new coexist, and its diverse cultures blend seamlessly, creating a series of captivating scenes under the interplay of light and shadow! Hosts Chris Lai and Winki Lai guide viewers through different movie locations, revisiting classic scenes and memorable quotes, evoking touching memories. Follow the program's carefully selected routes to admire the dazzling cityscape and immerse yourself in the world of cinema. The hosts will also demonstrate photo-taking techniques, teaching viewers how to capture the unique charm of this "City of Light and Shadow" with their cameras. In addition, film actors revisit filming locations, reminiscing about their past shoots; action directors share their insights on designing action scenes, showcasing the allure of Hong Kong cinema.

programme.title: Mystery Files
programme.desc: Love is an extremely complex subject, surrounded by numerous “environmental factors” that can alter our dreams and understanding of romance. These factors—ranging from changes in age and the rise of internet culture to the emergence of scams and other seemingly unusual reasons—have led to bizarre, worldview-shattering love stories in society. The TVB Plus live show " Mystery Files" hosted by Fire Lee, Jinny Ng, and Randal Tsang, invites people from all walks of life, celebrity guests, and relationship experts to discuss each episode's theme. With unique perspectives and thought-provoking questions, they boldly explore emotional dilemmas, while also welcoming viewers to join the conversation and solve problems together through the live chatroom and call-ins.

programme.desc: "'You Are Not Alone' triumphantly returns! programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord (Moses Chan). However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin (Edwin Siu) is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam (Nancy Wu) and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok (Matthew Ho) to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lam's status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning (Kelly Cheung). A “war on drugs" again breaks out …

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Cantopop At 50
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. " Cantopop At 50" invites original singers or accomplished vocalists to reinterpret these once-popular classics that transcend generations, delivering high-quality musical enjoyment to music lovers. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.title: Hong Kong Good Take
programme.desc: Hong Kong possesses a unique urban character, where old and new coexist, and its diverse cultures blend seamlessly, creating a series of captivating scenes under the interplay of light and shadow! Hosts Chris Lai and Winki Lai guide viewers through different movie locations, revisiting classic scenes and memorable quotes, evoking touching memories. Follow the program's carefully selected routes to admire the dazzling cityscape and immerse yourself in the world of cinema. The hosts will also demonstrate photo-taking techniques, teaching viewers how to capture the unique charm of this "City of Light and Shadow" with their cameras. In addition, film actors revisit filming locations, reminiscing about their past shoots; action directors share their insights on designing action scenes, showcasing the allure of Hong Kong cinema.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: News Magazine 2026
programme.desc: "News Perspective" is a weekly program featuring in-depth coverage of notable news stories from Hong Kong and around the world. It focuses on social issues that matter most to Hong Kong residents and invites people from various sectors, scholars, and experts to discuss and analyze the underlying causes and developments.

programme.title: Le Grand Tour de Seoul
programme.desc: The "Le Grand Tour de Seoul" is on its way again, with Samantha Ko, Kalok Chow, and Brian Chu set off to enjoy a fantastic stay in Seoul! The hosts will visit local Michelin-starred restaurants and savor top-quality Korean beef. Beyond the culinary adventure, the two male hosts will also have the opportunity to work out with Korean star and fitness icon Kim Jong-kook, followed by a delicious barbecue. The three will also enjoy personalized activities: Samantha will have a romantic date with a ceramic artist; Brian Chu will experience bespoke tailoring, showcasing his impeccable style; and Kalok will try on a styling session inspired by a top Korean celebrity, undergoing a glamorous makeover. This exclusive and enjoyable experience will lead viewers to the ultimate in Seoul's luxurious charm!

programme.title: Mystery Files
programme.desc: Love is an extremely complex subject, surrounded by numerous “environmental factors” that can alter our dreams and understanding of romance. These factors—ranging from changes in age and the rise of internet culture to the emergence of scams and other seemingly unusual reasons—have led to bizarre, worldview-shattering love stories in society. The TVB Plus live show " Mystery Files" hosted by Fire Lee, Jinny Ng, and Randal Tsang, invites people from all walks of life, celebrity guests, and relationship experts to discuss each episode's theme. With unique perspectives and thought-provoking questions, they boldly explore emotional dilemmas, while also welcoming viewers to join the conversation and solve problems together through the live chatroom and call-ins.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Shaw Prize Special 2026, The & Yes, Boss.
programme.desc: The 2026 Shaw Prize in Life Sciences and Medicine will be awarded equally to Anne Deschamps, Dai Yuge, and Chen Zhu for their discovery of the molecular and cellular pathogenic basis of acute promyelocytic leukemia and for pioneering synergistic targeted therapy, which has transformed this disease from one of the deadliest cancers to one of the most curable cancers, with a cure rate of over 90%.

programme.title: Try It? Really? (Sr.2)
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the "Try It Out Team," returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the island's heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the show's spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the city's corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers.

programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)
programme.desc: The dating reality show "A Date with Goddess" is back with a bang, and the second season's love battlefield is all upgraded! "Golden Matchmaker" Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the "heart-fluttering light" and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks… More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses' hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the "Peanut Team," providing live coverage of the goddesses' dates.

programme.title: Star Weekly
programme.desc: The talk show "Star Weekly" invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special "Fact Check" segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth!

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews; they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries; renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in "Food News Report," highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Finance Magazine 2026
programme.desc: "Financial Insights" keeps a close watch on the market, reviewing weekly trends in Hong Kong stocks and paying attention to the real estate sector. Through exclusive interviews with industry professionals and market analysis, the program explores popular local and international finance topics in a clear and accessible manner. It also features in-depth reports on the challenges faced by different industries as they develop.
